copy.headline: U2 will bring 'Greatest Show' to Arlington on 2027 world tour
copy.caption: Iconic rock band U2 will embark on their first large-scale tour since 2018 with their Carnaval De Luz presents: The Greatest Show On Earth World Tour 2027.

story.title: U2 will bring 'Greatest Show' to Arlington on 2027 world tour
story.summary: Iconic rock band U2 will embark on their first large-scale tour since 2018 with their Carnaval De Luz presents: The Greatest Show On Earth World Tour 2027 , which will include a stop at AT&T Stadium in Arlington on Monday, September 27.
